name: Jump through the night from the minute-by-minute list (console) (signed in)
description: Validates that clicking an event in the minute-by-minute list moves the replay to its minute, marks that row's list item as the current step, updates the anchor status, and writes the minute into the URL.

planSteps.description: Type testsprite-console-05+clerk_test@example.com in the "Email address" field and click Continue
Wait until the code screen ("Check your email") shows "Didn't receive a code?", then type 424242; Clerk usually continues by itself after the 6th digit, so click Continue only if it is still shown

If Clerk answers "You need to send a verification code before attempting to verify", click Resend once it is enabled and type 424242 again; then wait up to 30 seconds until the URL is no longer under /sign-in
Navigate to /cases/eagle-s-2024 and wait up to 60 seconds for the 3D view (data-testid seabed-view) to reach data-state "ready"

In the list headed "25 December, minute by minute" (data-testid event-list) in the panel on the right of the 3D view (click "Show panel" first if it is folded), click the row "Cinia detects a fault on C-Lion1"
Assert the replay clock (data-testid replay-clock) reads "16:44 UTC" and the anchor status (data-testid replay-anchor-status) reads "Anchor dragging on the seabed"
Assert the row "Cinia detects a fault on C-Lion1" is the list's current row: it is highlighted on the grey tone and its list item (li) has aria-current="step", and no other row is highlighted
Click the row "Police and Border Guard board the tanker from helicopters"
Assert the replay clock reads "22:28 UTC", the line right under it reads "26 Dec 2024, 00:28 in Helsinki", and the anchor status reads "Drag ended at 16:45"

Assert the row "Police and Border Guard board the tanker from helicopters" is now the current row (highlighted, its li with aria-current="step") and the row "Cinia detects a fault on C-Lion1" is no longer highlighted
Assert the URL query has t=2024-12-25T22:28Z
